_doc: Minh Loan Các signature items (rules-proposals R7; design/items record). Unpriced proposals; modifier sizes follow the metal and earth catalogues' grade 2-4 items. One set of two: the jade pendants and the luan bell of the founders' rite (960).

items.name: Singing Luan Bell (Minh Loan Linh)

effects.name: Rings as It Moves (Hành Minh)
effects.rule: The bell rings whenever the foe presses or dodges: it takes a light Metal hit and gains one Metal stack, at most once per second.

items.lore: A bronze carriage bell in the shape of a luan bird, the first bell Yến Bội Ngọc cast at the coast in 960 (V102). It rang at her Dao-partner rite with Hoa Minh Hòa, against the jade pendants he carved, and the pavilion is named for the two together (Vương Bột: bội ngọc minh loan).
items.build_use: The head's ward bell: Metal stacks on the foe each second it presses.

items.name: Jade Pendants (Bội Ngọc)
items.lore: Three pendants of Lam Ngọc blue jade on one cord, carved by Hoa Minh Hòa for the rite of 960 and tuned so that they chime against the luan bell. Yến has worn them since he died in 1121. She hears the chime as his.
items.build_use: Health and sustain; Earth stacks to sit beside the bell's Metal.

items.name: The Winter Crack (Đông Liệt Chung)
items.lore: The great bell Hoa Minh Hòa was casting in the cold winter of 1121 (V100). It cracked in the pit and killed him (N-minh_loan-02). It rings flat. Ngụy Trầm Âm keeps it on the casting floor and strikes it beside every new bell: a bell that rings true against the Winter Crack may be sold.
items.build_use: The casting master's bell: long Metal stacks and cold resistance.

items.name: Little Answering Bell (Ứng Hưởng Linh)
items.lore: A hand bell Thẩm Hưởng Nhi cast at entry in 1176, tuned to the forty bells she later hung on the Cloud Bridge. When they ring, it answers. Since 1191 it has also answered on nights when they ring with no wind.

items.name: Robe of the Ringing Rite (Minh Lễ Bào)
items.lore: Her rite robe of 960, with bronze thread at the hem so that it rang against the bell and the jade. She had it rewoven after 1121 with one thread of the Winter Crack's bronze.

items.name: Lam Ngọc Jade Chip (Lam Ngọc Bội)
items.lore: A chip of blue jade from her father's cutting floor at Lam Ngọc Khoáng, drilled to hang beside the hand bell. It hums with the bridge bells too.
items.build_use: Metal stacks that hold, and a steady head among the bells.

sets.name: Pendant and Bell (Bội Ngọc Minh Loan)

bonuses.effect: Struck, She Rings (Kích Nhi Minh): each hit you take rings the Luan Bell as though the attacker had moved (a light Metal hit and a Metal stack on it), and the Pendants chime back: each chime heals you 1 % of your health, at most once per second.

sets.story: Cast and carved together for the founders' Dao-partner rite in 960, when the bell rang against the jade. In Vương Bột's line the jade pendants and the luan bells fall silent when the feast is over. Yến Bội Ngọc wears both, and the set is whole. The rite robe she wore that day is the third piece; she had it rewoven with a thread of the Winter Crack in 1121, and wears all three.

sets.name: Bridge Bells (Kiều Linh Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Forty Answer (Tứ Thập Ứng): bells you hang with Hang the Bells answer your hand bell: each time the foe acts, every Bell charge you hold rings once, each a light Metal hit; at most once per second.

sets.story: The hand bell and the jade from home. Thẩm Hưởng Nhi holds both; since 1191 both have answered on nights with no wind.
